userStories.title: Add demoteIssueOnMain core writer + default wiring
userStories.description: As the cam issue system, I need a deterministic on-main writer that flips a stage:specified issue back to stage:idea so a defective spec can be re-grilled through the sanctioned CLI instead of hand-editing JSON or abandon+refile.
acceptanceCriteria: demoteIssueOnMain in src/commands/issue-specify.ts sets stage:'idea' on a stage:'specified' issue and commits ONLY that issue's CAM-NNNN.json on main via commitTreeToMain with commit message `chore(cam): demote <id>`, mirroring closeIssueOnMain/abandonIssueOnMain (in-process, no tmux, no LLM). [oracle: grep -q "chore(cam): demote" src/commands/issue-specify.ts]

Guards run in the canonical order: (0) up-to-date guard reusing checkMainUpToDate (detached-head, missing-main, diverged); (1) target id exists (not-found); (2) the stage transition guard allows ONLY specified->idea. An idea, planned, or shipped issue is each refused with its own distinct reason token (never a single blanket wrong-stage), so the planned case in particular is refused because a PRD is in flight and demoting would strand it. [oracle: bun test test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts]

Demote flips only the stage axis: the existing (stale) spec, wsjf, blockedBy, and all other fields on the entry are preserved so they remain available as reference for the re-grill. [oracle: bun test test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts]

defaultDemoteIssueFn(cwd, id) is exported from src/release/post-merge.ts, wrapping demoteIssueOnMain with the real-spawnSync + ISO-clock closure, placed next to defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn so the real-spawnSync closure lives in exactly one place (jscpd gate). [oracle: grep -q 'defaultDemoteIssueFn' src/release/post-merge.ts]

No --respec or spec-overwrite path is introduced: specifyIssueOnMain's Guard 4 stays idea-only (the `entry.stage !== 'idea'` -> wrong-stage guard is unchanged). [oracle: grep -q "entry.stage !== 'idea'" src/commands/issue-specify.ts]

A real-git integration test (test/integration/issue-specify-ref-only.test.ts) proves the on-main path leaves the worktree coherent with HEAD (commitTreeToMain's final syncWorktreeIfOnMain step) and that `git show main:scripts/cam/issues/CAM-NNNN.json` reflects stage:idea after demote. [oracle: bun test test/integration/issue-specify-ref-only.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/commands/issue-specify.ts (add DemoteIssueOnMainOptions/Result/Error/Outcome + demoteIssueOnMain, mirroring closeIssueOnMain at lines ~508-571), src/release/post-merge.ts (add defaultDemoteIssueFn next to defaultCloseIssueFn/defaultAbandonIssueFn at ~349-386), test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts, test/integration/issue-specify-ref-only.test.ts. Reuse checkMainUpToDate + pushMainBestEffort + commitTreeToMain('cam-specify-' tmp prefix) already in issue-specify.ts; do NOT copy git plumbing (jscpd threshold, see patterns.md 'Shared on-main commit-tree module' CAM-108/133 and 'New on-main caller' CAM-118). Guard-order + discriminated-union-errors convention: patterns.md 'Backlog mutation guard order' (CAM-107). Stages are the IssueStage union in src/issues/types.ts ('idea'|'specified'|'planned'|'shipped'). Worktree-coherence is automatic via commitTreeToMain -> syncWorktreeIfOnMain (patterns.md CAM-137/CAM-133): assert via `git show main:<path>`, not working-tree state. Distinct reason tokens suggested: already-idea (nothing to do), is-planned (PRD in flight, would strand), is-shipped. No stage-promoted-style event is required by the spec; only add an eventSink if you mirror one, otherwise keep it a plain writer.

userStories.title: Wire `cam issue demote <id>` CLI surface (parse + dispatch + help)
userStories.description: As an operator (or the orchestrator), I need `cam issue demote <id>` on the CLI so I can move a defective specified issue back to idea and get a machine-readable handback line consistent with close/abandon.
acceptanceCriteria: parseIssueArgs recognizes a `demote <id>` positional subcommand (evaluated before the free-text fallthrough, alongside list/close/abandon): a missing id is a parse error, an extra positional is a parse error, and ParsedIssueArgs gains a `{ mode: 'demote'; id: string; help: false }` member. [oracle: bun test test/issue-dispatch.test.ts]

dispatchIssue handles mode 'demote' via IssueDispatchDeps.demoteIssueOnMainFn (default: defaultDemoteIssueFn(process.cwd(), id)); on ok:true it prints the success hint and writes `CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=<id>` to stdout and returns 0; on ok:false it printErrors and writes `CAM_ISSUE_RESULT=ERROR reason=<reason>` and returns 1, exactly mirroring the close/abandon branches. [oracle: bun test test/issue-dispatch.test.ts]
The `cam issue` help/usage text lists `demote <id>` with a one-line description (specified->idea for re-spec), alongside close/abandon. [oracle: grep -q 'demote' index.ts]
The dispatch-layer --help short-circuit (CAM-211) still fires for `cam issue demote --help` with no demote side effect. [oracle: bun test test/issue-dispatch.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: File: index.ts (four sibling sites per patterns.md 'Sibling axis-mutation CLI subcommand pattern' CAM-210, line ~148: ParsedIssueArgs union ~893-899, parseIssueArgs positional branch ~970-999, IssueDispatchDeps.demoteIssueOnMainFn + dispatchIssue branch ~1876-2027, ISSUE_HELP/usage ~332-365). Copy-paste the close/abandon shape 1:1; import defaultDemoteIssueFn from ./src/release/post-merge.ts (see line 53). Test: test/issue-dispatch.test.ts mirrors the existing close/abandon dispatch tests (inject demoteIssueOnMainFn, assert CAM_ISSUE_RESULT line + exit code). SPEC-vs-CONVENTION NOTE: the CAM-206 spec text writes `cam issue --demote <id>` (flag form), but close/abandon are POSITIONAL subcommands and patterns.md CAM-210 explicitly designs the next sibling as positional (`reopen <id>`). This story implements the positional `cam issue demote <id>` for 1:1 consistency with its siblings; the functional WHAT (specified->idea, guards, handback) is identical either way. Flag this in the handoff so the reviewer knows the surface-token choice was deliberate. Depends on US-001 (needs demoteIssueOnMain + defaultDemoteIssueFn).
